desc:
⚠️THIS GAME IS INDEV, GAME IS NOT IN A STABLE RELEASE YET EXPECT BUGS ⚠️

There are currently 15 Levels in the game so far.

Controls can be found in the in-game menu!

>> Awoken and confused you find yourself in an entirely different world of the one you were originally accustomed to.

>> Your choices make up your fate, traverse the abnormal locations of this world. Find and craft new equipment to help you on your journey in the depths of reality.

>> You'll need it.

> Requirements
📈 Please have graphics on 6 and above for the best experience.

🎧 Have your volume on 3 bars or more.

🖥️📱🎮 Supports PC, Mobile, & Xbox.
